NFL 2026 season live on Sky Sports: Fixtures, kick-off times, TV channel for games this week and weekend
A look at the weekly NFL fixtures live on Sky Sports, with seven games live during Week 11; find out below which matches are live and when to watch throughout the season on Sky Sports NFL
Tuesday 17 November 2026 09:34, UK
When is NFL next live on Sky Sports? We take a look at this week's live action and which channels you can follow the matches on...
Kansas City Chiefs return to action amid their Super Bowl hunt as they host Arizona Cardinals exclusively live on Sky Sports NFL from 6pm.
Detroit Lions are back at home following their win over New England Patriots in Germany when they welcome Tampa Bay Buccaneers, before MVP-contending Trevor Lawrence leads Jacksonville Jaguars out at MetLife Stadium to take on the New York Giants.

WEEK 11

Monday November 23
Cincinnati Bengals @ Washington Commanders - KO 1.15am (Tuesday) - LIVE from 1am on Sky Sports NFL and Sky Sports Main Event.
Sky Sports at the heart of NFL coverage in UK and Ireland
Sky Sports will continue to deliver the most comprehensive coverage of the NFL in the UK and Ireland, broadcasting more than half of all NFL games live throughout the season across its channels.
This includes the usual Sunday evening double-headers, primetime matchups, NFL RedZone, NFL International Series games, Thanksgiving Day, the playoffs and Super Bowl LXI.
Fans can once again look forward to the best games every week on Sky, with the broadcaster having the first-pick exclusive game on Sunday at 6pm live on Sky Sports NFL and the first pick for the Sunday 9pm game.
There will continue to be more choice as a second game at 6pm and up to an additional two games at 9pm will also be shown live on Sky Sports concurrently.
For the 2026 season, Sky Sports is also increasing its on-the-ground production and broadcast presence in the United States, bringing fans closer to the live action from across the league, with enhanced reporting, storytelling and coverage from the home of American football.
Neil Reynolds, Phoebe Schecter and Jason Bell headline the regular Sunday presenting roster, while Bridget Condon and Ndamukong Suh fronting Sky Sports' live broadcast output from the US.
The in-season Sky Sports NFL channel will once again be the round-the-clock home of the NFL on linear in the UK and Ireland from the regular season all the way through to Super Bowl LXI, which will be live from SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California, on Sunday February 14, 2027.

רשת Sky Sports תמשיך לספק כיסוי נרחב לעונת ה-NFL לשנת 2026 עם שידורים חיים של שבעה משחקים מרכזיים במהלך שבוע 11. בין המפגשים הבולטים העולים לשידור, קנזס סיטי צ'יפס תארח את אריזונה קרדינלס, דטרויט לוינס תפגוש את טמפה ביי באקנירס, וג'קסונוויל ג'אגוארס תשחק מול ניו יורק ג'איינטס במטלייף סטדיום. בנוסף, לאס וגאס ריידרס תתמודד מול דנוור ברונקוס.

המחזור יכלול גם את משחק הבינלאומי התשיעי והאחרון של העונה, שבו מינסוטה ויקינגס תפגוש את סן פרנסיסקו 49ers במקסיקו סיטי. הרשת תמשיך להציע סיקור מקיף הכולל משחקי לילה, אולפנים ופרשנויות לאורך העונה הסדירה ועד למשחק הסופרבול שיערך בפברואר 2027 בפארק שבקליפורניה.
